title: Homely Australian Baked Scones
description: Moist and comforting, these scones are perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. Featuring vanilla bean paste and a hint of sweetness from the mirepoix-based mixture.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality all-purpose flour for the best results

ingredients.name: cold unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: keep the butter cold for a flaky texture

ingredients.name: vanilla bean paste
ingredients.notes: use high-quality vanilla bean paste for the best flavor

ingredients.name: mirepoix-based mixture
ingredients.notes: see notes for the mirepoix-based mixture recipe

ingredients.name: large eggs
ingredients.notes: use room temperature eggs for the best results

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vanilla bean paste and mirepoix-based mixture.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead a few times until it comes together.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out the scones. Gather the scraps, re-form the dough, and cut out additional scones. You should end up with 8-10 scones.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) of space between each scone.
Brush the tops of the scones with a little bit of extra butter.
Bake the scones for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Remove the scones from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for a few minutes before serving.
